literal: Greatness along with glory will depart, if those who possess good nature speak useless things.
translation: If people of noble character speak useless words, their greatness, along with their glory, will depart from them.
modern: நற்குணங்களை உடையவர்கள் பயனில்லாத சொற்களைப் பேசினால், அவர்களுடைய பெருமையும் சிறப்பும் அவர்களை விட்டு நீங்கிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns that even people who naturally possess a good and noble character (நீர்மையுடையார்) will lose their standing if they indulge in useless talk. The word 'சீர்மை' refers to their inherent greatness or dignity, while 'சிறப்பு' refers to the external glory or distinction they have earned. Both of these qualities will vanish (நீங்கும்) the moment they speak words that lack substance or benefit (பயனில). Thus, the poet emphasizes that maintaining one's reputation requires constant vigilance over one's speech.
